top_candidates.original_title: OpenAI's fall from grace as investors race to Anthropic
top_candidates.generated_headline: OpenAI’s Quiet Unraveling: How Investor Flight to Anthropic Exposes Benchmark Gaps

top_candidates.original_title: Eight years of wanting, three months of building with AI
top_candidates.generated_headline: The Local Execution Trap vs. Global Architecture
top_candidates.summary: AI excels at local code execution but fails at global architectural design. While it can generate hundreds of tests and functional snippets, it lacks the foresight to manage complex interactions between components, leading to unmaintainable 'spaghetti' code if not guided by human-led design principles. Quote: Architecture is what happens when all those local pieces interact, and you can’t get good global behaviour by stitching together locally correct components.
